marker: original C zwsp_k = U+200B repeated worker index, then newline, before context
selection: first 30 eligible records in original order; native token length 1024..29000; no truncation and no outcome-based selection
aggregation: QA official-normalized majority vote; summary/synthetic model merge; aggregation use separately logged and excluded from worker CAF_cache
requested_test: two-sided Mann-Whitney U per native metric, with rank-biserial effect size
supplemental_tests: paired quality differences and bootstrap CI, paired Wilcoxon; nonsignificance is not equivalence
scope: controlled RAG prepend; mechanism generalization and output quality; no single-asset end-to-end delivery claim
map_section_rule: five contiguous word-count spans of original full context; 10-word start/end cues in per-agent suffix
sanity_rule: first 3 fixed HotpotQA and TriviaQA cases, first 1 summary and synthetic case; no outcome-based sample replacement
